title.narrative: Prospects for freely chosen and productive employment are maintained and expanded for women and men through migration and better preparedness for jobs and sustainable entrepreneurship in global value chains

description.narrative: ILO has a long-term partnership with the government of Viet Nam and social partners to enhance labour migration governance to address decent work challenges, including exploitative work environments for Vietnamese migrant workers. During this biennium, the ILO supports its tripartite constituents in Viet Nam to continue (a) monitoring recruitment costs and take further steps to reduce and move towards the exemption of recruitment and migration costs for all workers; (b) delivering services through migrant workers resource centres (MRCs) to support accessibility of migrant workers to reliable information and legal assistance and (c) building capacity and technical support for tripartite constituents to regulate and enforce fair and ethical recruitment policies and decent work for fishers.
